category_title: Disengaged students with school avoidance tendencies who can perform simple reasoning
scenario_title: Transitioning from manipulatives to drawing for regrouping
minimal_context: The student is working individually to solve an arithmetic problem involving regrouping using a piece of paper with two leaves drawn on it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is a piece of paper with two leaves drawn on it. Please solve 14 plus 18.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I will write the math sentence. For the ones, 4 plus 8 is 12. I will carry the 2 to the tens and put the 1 at the ones.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Take a look and check your answer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I checked my answer. I don't see any errors.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try drawing the insects on the leaves to find the total.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks puzzled) It is very hard to draw so many insects. I don't want to do this.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here is a piece of paper with two leaves drawn on it. Please solve 14 plus 18.

STUDENT: I will write the math sentence. For the ones, 4 plus 8 is 12. I will carry the 2 to the tens and put the 1 at the ones.

TUTOR: Take a look and check your answer.

STUDENT: I checked my answer. I don't see any errors.

TUTOR: Try drawing the insects on the leaves to find the total.

STUDENT: (Looks puzzled) It is very hard to draw so many insects. I don't want to do this.
